name: Mallukas ja Kristina Austraalias
overview: Mallukas, Estonia's most read blogger and award-winning social media star, is heading to Australia with his fashionista girlfriend Kristina Pärtelpoja, where new shows and crazy travel adventures await them. They will definitely have to taste kangaroo meat, take a selfie with a koala, and alleviate the homesickness of their compatriots living far away with Estonian humor and partying in Estonian style.
